messages:
support_jordan: Hey team — customer AcmePay is seeing intermittent 500s on /v1/generate after we rotated the KMS key yesterday. They're also reporting some audit-log entries for those requests are missing, and they need ISO27001 evidence mapping for retention + key lifecycle. Repro steps below; opening here before I escalate to compliance. TL;DR: 500s + missing audit events after KMS rotation.

eli: thanks Jordan. Can you paste a minimal repro curl and the request id from the failures? Also which KMS key was rotated?

support_jordan: Repro curl:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.cloud/v1/generate \n -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-XXXXX" \n -H "X-Request-ID: 6b1f2c7a" \n -d '{"model":"redwood-3b","input":"hi"}'
```
Failed response: HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Response body: {"error":"service_unavailable","code":503}
Request id in logs: 6b1f2c7a
KMS key rotated: projects/prod/keys/ri-kms-2026-v2 (rotation 2026-03-15T03:12:00Z)

alex: I'm seeing matching trace for 6b1f2c7a in the proxy logs, backend returned 502 then 503 cascaded. Can you attach audit log export for timeframe 03:00-04:00Z? We should also confirm whether the audit-logging service had any outage during key rotation. :eyes:

support_jordan: attaching a small export (redacted) — pasted snippets below:
```
[2026-03-15T03:05:12Z] request_id=6b1f2c7a route=/v1/generate user=acmepay status=500 backend=lm-runtime err="tls: decryption error"
[2026-03-15T03:07:45Z] request_id=6b1f2c7a audit=NOT_WRITTEN reason="audit-queue-full"
```

maya: From compliance POV we need mapping to ISO27001 controls: A.12.4.1 (event logging), A.10.1 (cryptographic controls), A.18.1 (regulatory requirements) etc. Please confirm:
- exact retention window used for prod audit logs (S3 lifecycle policy name/id)
- whether audit writes are sync vs async during KMS key rotation
- evidence of key rotation process (who approved, KMS rotation schedule, key material origin/HSM flag)

eli: To add: did we switch to external HSM for that key? If so, we need HSM attestation doc link. If it's cloud-managed KMS, note the key ring and IAM binding changes.

support_jordan: Audit retention: s3://redwood-prod-audit/ -> lifecycle policy 'audit-retain-90d' (90 days then transition). Audit writes are async via queue (audit-writer service). The rotated key was created in Google KMS with CMEK; not in external HSM. Approval ticket: https://tickets.redwood.internal/TICKET-4521 (approved by ops@redwood).

maya: Okay — for ISO evidence we'll need:
- export of audit log for affected window (you pasted snippet, but we need full export file)
- audit-writer queue metrics (was it backpressure or backlog?)
- key rotation approval record and rotation schedule entry
- statement whether audit exports are immutable or can be rewritten (we should flag immutability for ISO)

alex: I'll correlate proxy, runtime, and audit-writer metrics. Quick ask: can you reproduce a failing call in staging with the same rotation pattern? If we can repro, we get deterministic logs. :thumbsup:

support_jordan: I can try a staged rotation tomorrow 03:00Z. For now I've uploaded the full CSV export to internal share: https://share.redwood.internal/audit-exports/1956789012-acme.csv

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-452 created for missing-audit-entries; severity P2. Pager notified: eng-sre, eng-infra.

maya: Thanks — I'll draft the mapping doc and assign action items. Jordan, please confirm when you run the staged rotation and paste the staging request ids so we can attach to the ISO evidence package.

support_jordan: Will do. ping me if you need any other fields. :lock:

eli: assigning to me for root cause triage. Will post updates here.

alex: noted, will pull logs and metrics.

maya: I'll start a compliance checklist doc and share link. :memo:

support_jordan: closing loop for now — thanks everyone.
